title: imap/listener: panic on bind failure instead of returning error
description: crates/imap/src/listener.rs run_plain_listener() line 27 and run_tls_listener() line 82 — both call panic\!('fatal: could not bind IMAP * listener') on TcpListener::bind failure. The callers are async tasks spawned under tokio::select\! in main.rs. A panic inside an async task propagates only to that task, not to the process; the other arms of the select continue running. This means a bind failure on the plain listener does not kill the process — the TLS listener may start serving while the plain port is silently absent, or vice versa. The function should return a Result or call std::process::exit() instead of panic\!().
